translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Melrmqng Jiszs
Krlc nzryapwxtrngr mz be ngr melrmqng Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Jiszs Kxnzmcpx vzpxm mz nqvi lr King Devet, x King Devet vzpxm mz nqvi lr Ebraam.

Ebraam mrlxde Aesak, x Aesak mrlxde Jekop. Jekop lc mrlxde Judz nidr badr mzledeng kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-esz', (kcng tzvzpx-ngrmqng nqvi lr ncblo kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-li (12) Israel, kc tqngi kzdq drtq Jekop).
Judz mrlxde Peres x Seera, lxedr kxtrngiulrJiu, drtqde Tama. Peres mrlxde Hesron, x Hesron mrlxde Ram.
Ram mrlxde Aminadab, Aminadab mrlxde Nason, x Nason mrlxde Salmon.
Salmon mrlxde Boas. Boas lc lxede drtqde Reab, kxtrngiulrJiu. X Boas mrlxde Obed, x lxede drtqde Rut, kxtrngiulrJiu kz, murde vzkimle mz drtc' ngr Moab. X Obed mrlxde Jesi.
Jesi lc, mrlxde King Devet.
Devet x Batsibz mrlxdr King Solomon. Batsibz nide kc tqngi kai olvz ngr Yuriz mzli kc trnznibqka-ngrde. Solomon mrlxde Reoboam. X Reoboam mrlxde Abaeja. X Abaeja mrlxde Asa.
Asa mrlxde Jeosafzt. X Jeosafzt mrlxde Jehoram. Yusaea melrmqde Jehoram.
Yusaea mrlxde Jotam. Jotam mrlxde Eas. Eas mrlxde Hesekaea.
Hesekaea mrlxde Manase. Manase mrlxde Amon. X Amon mrlxde Josaea.
Jekonaea nidr badr mzledeng, melrmqdr Josaea. Mz mzli nyz mzle-lzbq lcng, nide kc tzrtulrtr-ngrbz mz lr Israel nzvz-krdr Bxbilon mz nzngini-krdr kxnzawz-nrbalqng elr.
Mz nibr nzrvzmingr lr Israel Bxbilon, Jekonaea mrlxde Sealtil, Serubabel melrmqde Sealtil.
Serubabel mrlxde Abiud. Abiud mrlxde Eliakim, x Eliakim mrlxde Aso.
Aso mrlxde Sadok. Sadok mrlxde Akim. X Akim mrlxde Eliud.
Eliud mrlxde Eliesa, Eliesa mrlxde Matan x Matan mrlxde Jekop.
Jekop mrlxde Josip, Josip lc yrlztile Mxri, kc tqngi lxede Jiszs, kc tzrpibz Kxnzmcpx.

Nzmu narlwxq nrpr ngr leplz lcng, yzuo mz mzli nyz Ebraam, krlzbzle King Devet, e nrpr ngr leplz nzpnu-esz'-nrade-pwx. X yzuo mou, mz mzli nyz King Devet krlzbzle mzli kc lr Israel tzapusr-ngrdr kxnzawz-nrbalqng mrkc Bxbilon, nrpr ngr leplz krlz-mopwzle kx nzpnu-esz'-nrade-pwx. Yzuo mou, mzli lc x sc tqkrlzpebzle mzli kc tzrmcngr mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx, nrpr ngr leplz nzpnu-esz'-nrade-pwx mou.
Nzrmcngr Mz Jiszs

Krlc be ngr nzrmcngr mz Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. Kzdq kc nzyrlzngr nzatubqtibz mz mzlir Mxri kc tqngi lxede x kzdq ncblo drtqde Josip. Josip xpepxpele Mxri mz nzyrlzngr. Kxmule-esz' Mxri trnzmwi-lxblrkang mz Josip, a' yrpe kai mz zmatq ngr Mqngrkxtr.

Kx adcpxbz Mxri nzyrpe-krde mz Josip, Josip aotitx pnz drtwrde nzaxtx-krde Mxri, murde nide ncblo kx mnc-nqblq-zvzle Lou sc Mosis. A' rpile na-ale-kapqle murde ma tqamyabzle drtq Mxri mz nzobqkr leplz kxkqlu.

Mzli kc tqaotipengr drtwrde da lcng, kzdq enjrl ne Gct adcpx-lzbqbz bade mz nzrmwible-krde, rpibzle bade kx, “Josip, bzkq mwxlrq nztwz-krm Mxri nzngini-krde olvz rm. Murde nim nqvi lr King Devet, x doa la tqyr-ngrde ngi-batrpz Mqngrkxtr, a' trngiu ncblo.
Sa narmc mz doa x napibzme drtqde Jiszs, kc drtwr ngrde Yawe arlapx, murde sa na-arlapxle leplz mz nzbz-krdr mz alwx ngrdrng.”
Krlc atutrle natq kc tqpibz Yawe mz profet Asaea mz nzrpi-krde kx,
“Kzdq doa olvz kxmnc-kamelr, narngine doa ncblo, x drtqde narpibz Imanuel,” kc drtwr ngrde Gct mncm bagu.
Zbz Josip dwalzm x sc tqyrlztipele Mxri, da kc tqwai nzpi-krbz enjrl kc le bade.
A' Josip trmwimileu Mxri vz, vz, x krlzbzle mzli kx nzrmcngr mz doa nede. X yrlq-kzpz Josip drtqde Jiszs.

footnotes.text: Gct esalz-ngrbzle mz King Devet kx Kxnzmcpx navzpxm mz nqvi lrde. [2 Samwel 7:11-17; 23:5; Sam 89:3-4, 19-37] X esalz-kz-ngrbzle mz Ebraam kx sa na-amrlzle leplz amrlx mz ncblo lc navzpxm mz nqvi lrde. [Nou 12:2-3]

Mz nzvz-nqblq-krde nqmq kr lr Jiu mz nzryrngr nqvi lr leplz, kzdung drtq leplz trnzyrou, murde trngiu da kx matq zlwz nzrkrlzngr drtqdr. A' kzdung mzli drtq leplz nzyro murde nzrpilr kx leplz nadcpx mz drtwrdr drtq lcng, da kc tqwaile mz dzu r nqvi lr leplz kcng tq mz ngalrde lcng. Mcku kx Matiu yrlqpxle kcng drtq melrmqng Jiszs murde kzdung drtq lcng mcku mz Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Kai. X mz nzrlwx-kz-krgu Nrpakxmrlz kxyr Luk, namcku kx drtq kcng tqyrleng yzuo mz nqvi lr King Devet krlzmle mzli nyz Jiszs bletipxngr mz drtq kcng mz buk sc Matiu. Kxmule-esz' a' nzryrngr lcng trnzvz-rbrung. Murde opxm kx nqvi lr leplz kc tqyr Luk ngi nqvi lr ncblo kx vzpx-ngrm Mxri, mz Devet. X drtq kcng tqyrng Matiu ngi nqvi lr ncblo kx vzpx-ngrm Josip, mz Devet. Kxmule-esz' Jiszs trngi-angidru mrlx Josip mz nrkrdrtq, a' mz lou scdr lr Jiu, Jiszs nipede mrlx Josip angidr. Yiz siu-esz' mz mzli nyz King Devet krlzmle mzli nyz Jiszs. X ycbz nqvi lr doa kcng mz Devet kx nzyrlz-etrng. Lrpzki kqlu kx naryapwx-nqblq-ngrbz mz nqvi lr Jiszs krlzbzle King Devet. Profet nzycmnetr-pnz-ngrdr kx Kxnzmcpx navzpxm mz nqvi lr King Devet. Delc tqmyapx-ngrbzle nzaelwapxngr kx Jiszs vzpx-angidrm mz nqvi lrde. Be kxmule lc takitrde nzesz'-krde mz nzaelwapx-krde kx Jiszs vzpxm mz nqvi lr Devet. A' mrlztx zlwz be ngrde nzli-krdr, krsc Matiu x krsc Luk.
Drtq lc tzrpibz Jiszs mzli kc nzrpibz Yesus mz natq lr Grik. A' mz natq kx ycmnengr Mxri, Josip x Jiszs kc tzrpibz Erameik, Jiszs nzrpibzlr Yesua. Drtq lc dekc tzrpibz mz Inglis Joshua.
